# 07.0 HTML Structure and Semantics Assessment

Select the correct answer for each question.

1. What is the purpose of semantic HTML?

   - [ ] To make websites load faster
   - [x] To describe the meaning and structure of content
   - [ ] To add visual styling to elements
   - [ ] To make code shorter

2. When should you use the article element?

   - [ ] For any section of content on the page
   - [x] For independently distributable, self-contained content
   - [ ] Only for blog posts
   - [ ] As a replacement for every div

3. Which approach adds an image accessibly?

   - [ ] An img element with no alt attribute
   - [ ] An img element with an empty alt attribute on a meaningful photo
   - [x] An img element with alt text that describes what the image shows
   - [ ] An image element that wraps the file name as text

4. Which heading order follows a correct hierarchy?

   - [ ] h1, then h3, then h2, then h4
   - [x] h1, then h2, then h3, then h4
   - [ ] h1, then h1, then h2, then h3
   - [ ] h2, then h4, then h6

5. Which element should you use for a navigation menu?

   - [ ] A div with a navigation class
   - [ ] A navigation element
   - [x] A nav element
   - [ ] A stack of br tags

6. When should you use an empty alt attribute on an image?

   - [ ] When you don't know what to write
   - [x] For decorative images that don't convey information
   - [ ] For all images, to save typing
   - [ ] Never; alt text is always required
